items.title: Association of Anxiety and Depression with Patient-Reported Outcomes After Functional and Aesthetic Rhinoplasty
items.fact_zh: 功能鼻整形490例，焦虑或抑郁者术后NOSE更差（35.3对24.1），翻修OR 2.56；美容组179例无差异。
items.take_zh: 功能鼻整形合并焦虑抑郁，术前就要讲清翻修风险高、症状改善打折；美容鼻整形不必因此劝退，满意度没差。
items.scene_zh: 功能上合并焦虑抑郁的，先把翻修率和改善幅度说在前面，别承诺一次到位。
items.fact_en: In 490 functional septorhinoplasties, anxiety/depression patients had worse postoperative NOSE scores (35.3 vs 24.1) and higher revision odds (OR 2.56); among 179 aesthetic cases there was no difference.
items.take_en: For functional cases, disclose the higher revision rate and smaller symptom gain; anxiety or depression should not disqualify aesthetic candidates, whose satisfaction was unaffected.

items.title: The Effects of Preservation and Structural Rhinoplasty on Voice Parameters
items.fact_zh: 40例女性鼻整形，术后3个月jitter、shimmer下降、HNR升高，两者相同；CPPS均无变化。
items.take_zh: 两种术式对嗓音只是细微扰动改善，别拿“术后声音更好”当卖点；CPPS没动，整体音质没有证据支持。
items.scene_zh: 声音不会变差，也说不上变好，这个别当承诺。
items.fact_en: In 40 women, both preservation and structural rhinoplasty lowered jitter and shimmer and raised HNR at 3 months, with no change in CPPS and no meaningful between-technique difference.
items.take_en: Only subclinical perturbation changes occurred; do not market voice improvement, since CPPS and overall voice quality did not change.

items.title: Menstrual cycle phase and early periorbital edema and ecchymosis after rhinoplasty: an observational study
items.fact_zh: 72例开鼻整形，术后1、3天眼周水肿淤青卵泡期最低，黄体期与排卵期较高。
items.take_zh: 能挑时间的话，把择期鼻整形排在卵泡期（月经结束后一周），淤青会轻些；这是探索性观察，别当铁律。
items.scene_zh: 时间能自己定的，月经干净后那一周做，眼睛肿和淤青会轻一点。
items.fact_en: In 72 women having open rhinoplasty, periorbital edema and ecchymosis on days 1 and 3 were lowest in the estimated follicular phase and higher in luteal and periovulatory phases.
items.take_en: Schedule elective rhinoplasty in the follicular week if the patient can choose, while treating this exploratory finding as hypothesis-generating rather than a rule.

items.title: Safety Profile of Standardized Tranexamic Acid (TXA) Dosing in Rhytidectomy: A Retrospective Comparative Cohort Study
items.fact_zh: 1036例面颈除皱，局麻药加TXA（均582.6mg）未增加缺血或全身并发症，无永久面神经麻痹。
items.take_zh: 局麻里加TXA安全性站得住，可以常规用；但这篇只证明“不更危险”，少出血少淤青的获益要靠别的证据。
items.scene_zh: 麻药里加TXA，一千多例没多出事，出血还少。
items.fact_en: In 1,036 face and neck lifts, TXA in local anesthetic (mean 582.6 mg) was not associated with more ischemic or systemic complications; no permanent nerve paralysis occurred.
items.take_en: The safety signal is reassuring enough for routine use, but this cohort only rules out added harm; the bleeding and bruising benefit rests on other studies.

items.title: Implant-Compensable Ptosis: A Retrospective Cohort Study Comparing Polyurethane Breast Augmentation Alone Versus Augmentation-mastopexy in Patients with Mild Ptosis
items.fact_zh: 90例聚氨酯假体，轻度下垂只放假体，24个月BREAST-Q 75.6对77.4（加悬吊），差1.8分。
items.take_zh: 轻下垂、不肯做悬吊的，选聚氨酯假体并控制容量≤350cc，可以只放假体；代价是乳头平均下移0.8cm。
items.scene_zh: 轻度下垂不想开悬吊，就用聚氨酯假体、容量别贪大，乳头会略往下走一点。
items.fact_en: In 90 women with polyurethane implants, implant-only augmentation in selected mild ptosis scored 75.6 on BREAST-Q at 24 months versus 77.4 for augmentation-mastopexy, with 36 minutes less operative time.
items.take_en: For mild ptosis patients who decline a lift, polyurethane implants at 350 cc or less are a defensible option, accepting about 0.8 cm of nipple descent and unproven non-inferiority.

items.title: A Next-Generation Approach to Subglandular Breast Augmentation Using B-Lite Implants: The Feather Touch Technique
items.fact_zh: 66例清醒状态肌下隆胸，多层筋膜平面阻滞全部完成、无改全麻，4例轻度位置问题，无严重并发症。
items.take_zh: 清醒隆胸技术上可行，关键在阻滞覆盖到位；但单组66例、IV级证据，别当成全麻的常规替代。
items.scene_zh: 想恢复快可以试清醒做，但别指望全程没感觉。
items.fact_en: In 66 women, awake subglandular augmentation with a multilayer fascial-plane block was completed without conversion to general anesthesia; four minor positional issues and no major complications.
items.take_en: Feasible when the block is thorough, but this is a single-arm level IV series and does not justify replacing general anesthesia as routine.
